blurbs.1: You once held a glass correctly. The sweater has begun.
blurbs.2: You can tell red from white. Dangerous knowledge.
blurbs.3: You order by the glass with mild confidence. Respectable.
blurbs.4: You know a region or two. Friends have started nodding along.
blurbs.5: Halfway to unbearable. The turtleneck is rising.
blurbs.6: You correct pronunciations gently. They notice.
blurbs.7: You swirl before you sip. The room adjusts.
blurbs.8: You speak in appellations. Ordinary wine lists fear you.
blurbs.9: Nearly peak snob. Only one wrong answer stands between you and the collar.
blurbs.10: Ultimate wine snob. The sweater has achieved liftoff. Bow before you.
